## UKHSA data analysis

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
hepC <- read_csv('data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv')
gt(head(hepC))
```

```{r}
rhino = read_csv('data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv')
ggplot(rhino, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
))+
  geom_line(colour = 'red')+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("Rhinovirus testing positivity by week")+
  ggtitle("Rhinovirus testing positivity by week by date")+
  theme_classic()
```
